articles.title: Anthropic Releases Claude 4 with Extended Reasoning and 2M Token Context
articles.summary: Anthropic has officially launched Claude 4, featuring a 2 million token context window and a new 'deep reasoning' mode that outperforms competitors on complex multi-step tasks. The model also introduces improved tool use and agentic capabilities, enabling it to autonomously execute long-horizon workflows. Benchmarks show significant gains over Claude 3.7 on coding, mathematics, and scientific reasoning tasks.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves Human-Level Performance on Medical Licensing Exams
articles.summary: Google DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 has scored above the 95th percentile on the USMLE and UK PLAB medical licensing examinations. The model demonstrates advanced multimodal diagnostic reasoning, interpreting MRI scans, lab results, and clinical notes simultaneously. The announcement has reignited debates around AI regulation in clinical settings.

articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Agent Platform for Enterprise Autonomous Workflows
articles.summary: OpenAI has unveiled a dedicated Agent Platform built on GPT-5, allowing enterprises to deploy autonomous AI agents that manage email, scheduling, data analysis, and customer service pipelines. The platform includes a new sandboxed execution environment and granular permission controls to limit agent actions. Early adopters including Salesforce and SAP have reported productivity gains of up to 40 percent.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Body Issues First Major Fine to Meta Over Llama Training Data
articles.summary: The newly established European AI Office has levied a €400 million fine against Meta, citing violations of the EU AI Act's transparency requirements regarding training data used for the Llama 4 series. Regulators allege Meta failed to adequately document data provenance and did not conduct required risk assessments before deployment. Meta has announced it will appeal the ruling.

articles.title: Microsoft Integrates RAG-Native Architecture Directly into Azure AI Foundry
articles.summary: Microsoft has announced that Azure AI Foundry now ships with a native retrieval-augmented generation layer, eliminating the need for third-party vector database integrations for most enterprise use cases. The new architecture supports hybrid dense-sparse retrieval and automatic document chunking with semantic awareness. Developers can deploy production-ready RAG pipelines with minimal configuration through updated SDK tooling.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Report Warns of Accelerating AI Capability Overhang in Open-Source Models
articles.summary: A new report from Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute highlights a growing 'capability overhang' in openly released models, where post-training techniques allow smaller models to punch far above their parameter weight. Researchers found that fine-tuned 70B models now routinely match 2024-era frontier performance on many benchmarks. The report calls for updated safety evaluation frameworks that account for post-deployment model modification.

articles.title: Runway Gen-4 Video Model Generates Coherent 10-Minute Cinematic Sequences
articles.summary: Runway has released Gen-4, a next-generation video generation model capable of producing up to 10 minutes of temporally consistent, cinematography-aware video from text or image prompts. The model maintains character and scene consistency across cuts, a long-standing challenge for generative video systems. Several independent filmmakers have already used early access to produce short films screened at the 2026 Tribeca Festival.

articles.title: LangChain Releases LangGraph 2.0 with Persistent Memory and Multi-Agent Orchestration
articles.summary: LangChain has launched LangGraph 2.0, a major overhaul of its agent orchestration framework featuring built-in persistent memory stores and native support for coordinating fleets of specialized sub-agents. The new version introduces a visual graph editor for designing agent topologies without code, aimed at lowering the barrier for non-engineer teams. The release has been widely praised by the developer community as a significant step toward production-grade agentic systems.
